item.title: Watercraft 0.1.1 Release
item.description: Watercraft 0.1.1 (Ketch) GitHub Repo released on GitHub as of 2026-10-15 This release contains important bug-fixes. The only things that have been updated are build scripts and provision scripts, everything else is unchanged. Bug Fixes Removed build time and install time artifacts that persisted onto the installed sytstem unexpectedly. liveuser and boatswain account sudoers.d rules autologin from the liveuser account Branding is no longer being overwritten. /etc/os-release is no longer a symlink and should always report Watercraft on installed systems now.
